name: Large Document Corpus Review Service
problem: Large public or authorized document productions are expensive to index, map, deduplicate and review without losing provenance.
inputs: Public or owner-authorized corpus, review question/scope and applicable privilege/privacy boundaries.
outputs: Corpus ingestion, subdocument mapping, deduplication, evidence index and review packets with provenance.
pricing: Current hypothesis $1,500-$25,000/project depending on corpus size/scope; not auto-quotable yet.
confirmation: Only public or owner-authorized corpora. Paid scope and privileged handling require explicit authorization.
invocation_status: Discoverable capability; upload/payment disabled pending rights/security verification.
